user.title: Connect to netboi
user.description: Create an API key in netboi under Settings → Integrations, then paste it here. A censored-only key never exposes real amounts to Home Assistant.

error.cannot_connect: Could not reach netboi at that URL.

abort.already_configured: This netboi API key is already configured.

data.reveal_ttl_minutes: Default auto-conceal after reveal (minutes, 0 = stay revealed)
data.expose_real_sensors: Expose real-currency sensors (writes real amounts into HA history while revealed)
